# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is a large bundle of raw call snippets, but only a modest slice is genuine **sales/enquiry/dealer-negotiation** conversation. The majority of the transcript is internal/operational chatter — loading/unloading disputes, driver-direction calls, bill-copy/invoice-copy handovers, gift-distribution logistics, e-way-bill/government-shutdown worries, bank/payment-transfer issues, and a couple of unrelated personal/distress calls. These have been excluded.

The real sales material that remains shows **Crayon Roofing & Structures** (factory/office in Manali, Chennai) operating as a **JSW-brand metal roofing sheet distributor and multi-item hardware supplier** — not a fixing/fabrication contractor. Enquiries come from fabricators, steel traders, small retail "profilers," site owners, and repeat dealers (some via WhatsApp/phone after seeing the number online). Because the dataset is dominated by logistics noise and very short rate-check calls, this KB is necessarily built from many **short, transactional snippets** rather than long consultative calls — treat the "scripts" below as patterns repeated across dozens of near-identical short exchanges, not single detailed calls.

## Products & brand ladder

Crayon explicitly states: *"Sir JSW metal roofing sheet நம்ம பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம். Supply பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம் sir. Fixing எதுவும் பண்றது கிடையாது."* [We only supply JSW metal roofing sheets; we don't do fixing/fabrication.]

**Roofing sheet brand ladder (JSW family, sold by Crayon):**
- **JSW Color On Plus** – top-tier, all colours available (sky blue, off white, grey, blue, red, brick red, CH variants). Thickness 0.40–0.60 mm, AZ70/AZ150 coating. "150 GSM" = 0.50 mm with ~15-year warranty; "70 GSM" = 0.47 mm, cheaper, shorter life but same brand warranty per thickness (*"2 thickness-க்கும் ஒரே year warranty தான்"*).
- **Pragathi / Pragathi Plus** – cheaper line, limited stock colours: *"sky blue off white மட்டும் தான் இருக்கும்"* — only sky blue and off-white regularly; grey/brick red/green **not normally stocked**, must be sourced externally for 10-ton+ orders.
- **Indradhanush (JSW)** – budget/thin-gauge line, 0.40–0.45 mm, AZ70, sky blue/half-white only.
- **Silver On / Silver On Plus** – bare galvalume (AZ150), sold by kg, used as a lower-cost "bare" alternative to colour-coated sheet.

**Other products confirmed in calls:**
- PUF (puff) roof panels – 50 mm panel, sold per sqm.
- Polycarbonate sheets (2 mm standard).
- Decking sheets – 0.8 mm / 1.0 mm / 1.2 mm.
- Flashings & accessories: L-flash, ridge/crimp pieces, roofing-through screws, needle/stitch screws, self-cleaning screws (free giveaway item mentioned).
- Tata-brand hardware: screws (1", 1.5", 2", 2.5", 130 mm self-tapping with EPDM washer), welding electrodes (2.5 mm, 3.15 mm), welding rods, CO2 welding wire/coil, cutting & grinding wheels.
- "Barricade sheet" for commercial-site hoarding — explicitly confused with normal profiling; rep had to ask customer for spec before quoting.

Crayon does **not** stock: grey as regular stock, black colour, UPVC sheet, 0.8 mm aluminum-coating grade, galvanized plain sheet in some sizes — these are repeated "no stock" answers.

| JSW Color On Plus 0.47 mm AZ150 | ₹430–445 + GST / sqm |
| JSW Color On Plus 0.6 mm AZ150 (sky blue) | ₹560 + GST (18%) / sqm |

**Standing commercial terms observed in calls:**
- Pricing is quoted either **per square meter** or **per kg**; reps repeatedly clarify which basis a customer wants because kg-basis invites "weight padding" disputes (*"200 g extra வச்சுதான் போடுவாங்க"* — vendors round up weight when billing in kg).
- **Cash-and-carry price is ₹1–2/kg cheaper than credit price** — stated explicitly multiple times as policy, not negotiable beyond that.
- Bulk/dealer quantity still gets "same rate as shop dealers," no extra secret discount — reps insist price given is "best rate," same as given to regular shopkeepers.
- **50% advance payment** required before production starts on bespoke/cut orders; some orders need full payment before dispatch confirmation.
- 1st-of-month price hikes are flagged proactively — reps call customers before month-end to push orders through at old rates (~10% hike warned for Tata welding rod/screw/cutting-wheel range).
- Non-standard colours (grey, brick red) require a minimum tonnage (~10 ton) before the factory will "run specially and deliver."
- Standard delivery promises: "Monday after lunch," "Wednesday," 1-week lead time for bulk, 2–3 days for accessories/screws; stock-outs on small items (1"screw, 2.5" double-thread) routinely push delivery to "next week" or "31st."

## Objection Playbook

**1. "Competitor/another dealer is giving it cheaper" (APJ/Musameen/Sarava Steel undercutting with ₹98–98.50 vs our ₹100–101)**
- Response used: don't drop below the stated cash-and-carry floor; verify who actually quoted the lower rate and on what basis (rotation/loss-leader sale) before reacting — *"ஒருத்தன் ஒரு மாசம் கட்டிட்டு இருக்குன்னு பாப்பானுங்க"* [he's taking a one-month loss just to keep volume rotating].
- Escalate to management/MD for confirmation rather than matching price on the spot: *"நான் office-ல Phone பண்ணி இந்த rate குடுக்குறீங்களான்னு நான் கேக்குறேன்."*

**2. "Why is square-meter rate so high compared to kg rate I heard elsewhere?"**
- Clarify billing basis explicitly before quoting: *"kg basis-ங்களா, square meter-ங்களா?"* Explain weight is operator-estimated and tends to be padded, so square-meter is the "fixed, fair" option.

**3. "Can you give any discount?" (bulk dealer orders)**
- Standard line: *"best rate தான் கொடுத்திருக்கோம்... கடைக்காரங்களுக்கு என்ன price கொடுப்போமோ
